comment: Each occurrence documents ONE occurrence of ONE forbidden token in ONE file at ONE line. The token is referenced by its stable token_id (SHA-256 prefix), never by the literal token string. The scanner verifies every (path, token_id, ordinal) matches a real occurrence in the current source by comparing line_sha256. A new occurrence at a new (path, ordinal) fails. A line_sha256 drift fails. Stale allowances fail.
